actualPerformanceBindings.actualTaskAndSolution: M1/task1 require two explained dated changes and correctly separated proposal, joint adoption, political direction and accountability.
M2/task2 apply conferral, non-exclusive subsidiarity and proportionality to cross-border spare parts versus locally adaptable repair classes.
M4/task4 assess two actual participation routes, recipients, democratic links and unequal access; initiative cannot enact the law.
M3/task3 analyse all three agricultural/environmental/trade decision-and-implementation chains with the exclusive/shared distinction.
M4/task5 analyse each group interest/resource, possible influence and two transparent participation rules without inferring corruption/majority.
M5/task6 compare the three supplied mechanisms and diagnoses across repairability and weak demand, with limits and reasoned conditional recommendation.
